info.title: Lunate - a coding agent for the terminal.
info.description: A native C# coding agent for the terminal.

commands.name: roslyn
commands.description:
serve the read-only Roslyn C# tools over
stdio to another MCP client (nothing but protocol
on stdout)

commands.name: theme.json
commands.description:
--system-prompt <text>         replace the composed system prompt wholesale,
including the tool-call conventions: the caller
owns them
--append-system-prompt <text>  append a section after the composed system prompt
A value may also be given as --flag=value; this is how to pass a value that begins with '-'.
A prompt after -- is taken verbatim, never as a flag; -- with no prompt is a usage error.

options.name: --continue
options.description:
continue the newest session recorded for this
working directory

options.name: --resume
options.description:
choose a session from the interactive picker
(print mode cannot draw it; use --session or

options.name: --session
options.description: load one session by id or file path

options.name: --session-id
options.description:
create or continue the session with this id in
this working directory (1-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ -,
starting with a letter or digit, no '..')

options.name: --no-session
options.description: run without writing a session file

options.name: --model
options.description: use this model for the run (wins over settings)

options.name: --thinking
options.description: off, low, medium or high for the run

options.name: --tools
options.description: expose only these comma-separated tool names

options.name: --extra-tools
options.description: enable optional search tools (grep, find, ls)

options.name: --no-tools
options.description: expose no tools for the run

options.name: --max-steps
options.description: stop the run after n model calls (default 50)

options.name: --max-cost
options.description: stop the run at this cumulative session spend

options.name: --max-time
options.description: stop the run at this wall-clock limit (30s, 5m, 1h)

options.name: --allow-unpriced
options.description: allow a cost limit over a model with no known price

options.name: --env
options.description:
run process-backed tools in one docker or podman
container (docker:<image> or podman:<image>); wins
over the environment setting

options.name: --offline
options.description: skip the daily update check for this run

options.name: --notify
options.description:
send a desktop notification when a long turn ends
while the terminal window is not focused

options.name: --fullscreen
options.description:
run the session on the alternate screen; inline is
the default

options.name: --theme
options.description:
paint with default, dark, light, ansi16 or mono, or
read the token file at <path> instead of the user's
theme.json

options.name: --system-prompt
options.description:
replace the composed system prompt wholesale,
including the tool-call conventions: the caller
owns them

options.name: --append-system-prompt
options.description: append a section after the composed system prompt
